decisions.decision: Figma is the design-system authority. On disagreement Figma wins: flag it, change Figma first, then code.
Figma's variant names win. Real code-only options are added to Figma rather than deleted from code.
A property that carries a value (checked, on/off, dismissible) gets its own Figma property — it is not a Variant.
Prototypes live in app/prototypes/<slug> and never modify the library. Gaps are composed locally from primitives and logged as candidates.
App code uses semantic tokens only. Primitive ramps (--atlas-color-*) are for token definitions, not components or screens.
Keep packages/ui-web. No restructure into src/components — that would be exactly the unrelated refactoring the harness forbids.
lg label uses --atlas-font-size-lg, continuing sm→text-sm, md→text-body. Not specified in Figma; confirm during the Checkbox metadata pass.
